programme.title: The Sea Monster
programme.desc: In the late Ming Dynasty, Lin Xiao, leader of the navy forces, sailed into unknown waters to prevent the Japanese pirates from obtaining an important treasure and to find his missing comrade.

programme.title: Treasure Hunt Deserter
programme.desc: In the early period of the Republic of China era, a deserter named PiSi tracks down a fake Taoist priest to Tianmen Town in Western Hunan to expose his corpse-driving scheme of abducting young girls.

programme.title: Desert Monster
programme.desc: An exploration team, which includes Liu Meng Xi & Xia Xuan, is sent to a biological laboratory. When disaster struck, the two barely escapes with samples of the mutant creature that attacked them.

programme.desc: Simon digs deep and faces down North Taiwan. Besides being initiated into an indigenous tribe, Simon will also journey through bizarre farms, mad landscapes and creepy cemeteries.

programme.title: The Food That Built the World S4
programme.desc: Before juice was everywhere, these innovators created the most nostalgic drink products and thirst quenchers of the last century, leading the charge on a new billion-dollar beverage industry.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens S16
programme.desc: The ancient Sumerians established the world's first civilisation, and they credited their achievements to their gods, the Anunnaki. But is it possible these powerful beings were extraterrestrial visitors?

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny S2
programme.desc: Victory is often forged in the shadows. A French Resistance operative hides explosives in baguettes to cripple a Nazi factory, and Ukrainian forces deploy AI-guided drones to strike a Russian bomber fleet.

programme.title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd S2
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered about the most bizarre things that have fallen from the sky? From meteorites to seafood and even bathtubs, these are some truly unbelievable stories of what comes from above.

programme.title: The UnXplained With William Shatner S8
programme.desc: From colossal walls and giant stone tombs to temples carved from solid rock, how did ancient civilisations achieve feats of engineering that still defy modern understanding?

programme.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren
programme.desc: How do you master a planet covered by 70% water? Build machines to conquer it. Dolph Lundgren dives into the German U-boats that nearly won WWII and the aircraft carrier that faced down nuclear war.

programme.title: History's Greatest Warriors
programme.desc: The Spartan is one of the most powerful soldiers in the world from the 7th century BC to the 4th century BC. His unmatched discipline and dedication to rigorous military training begins in childhood.

programme.title: Modern Marvels: WWII
programme.desc: From the Bazooka and Cavity Magnetron radar to the Enigma code machine, engineers and scientists create faster and smarter tools that help win WWII and shape modern warfare.

programme.title: Lost U-Boats of WWII
programme.desc: With weather preventing Darrell Miklos and the team from diving from the boat, they attempt a risky strategy. Garth makes a solo journey to explore a deserted island where he discovers a mysterious cross.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: A family of strict parents and siblings who don’t get along with each other. After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.desc: Walaupun tidak memiliki fizikal dan stamina sebagi pemain bola tetapi Azman masih menyimpan cita-cita untuk menjadi pemain bola sepak yang berjaya.

After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Rimau Bangku
programme.desc: Walaupun tidak memiliki fizikal dan stamina sebagi pemain bola tetapi Azman masih menyimpan cita-cita untuk menjadi pemain bola sepak yang berjaya.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Rimau Bangku
programme.desc: Walaupun tidak memiliki fizikal dan stamina sebagi pemain bola tetapi Azman masih menyimpan cita-cita untuk menjadi pemain bola sepak yang berjaya.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: For one assignment, the students partner up, interview and write an essay about each other. Danial is partnered up, by random draw from a hat, with Amelia. They sit down and interview each other. Danial enjoys talking about himself while Amelia is a hard person to go through. When the essays are done, Amelia — being the best in the class in English — insists on checking Danial’s essay, because each pair shares a mark. Danial is reluctant at first because he’s insecure about his writing but finally gives up. She reads his essay and discovers that he’s written a flattering essay about her. She finally opens, telling him more about herself.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond asks the students to talk about their heroes. But they misunderstood and talk about their favourite superheroes instead. James Blond corrects them and tells them about the real meaning of a ‘hero’ and not fictitious heroes, for example his uncle Edward who’s an SAS army and a mountaineer. Sam, the quiet one in the class, is too shy to even speak a complete sentence. However, he seems to be confident when correcting people about these superheroes’ facts. He’s a real pedantic geek. James Blond decides to talk about a superhero in class, getting all the facts wrong, to get Sam to speak confidently. And Sam, can’t bear hearing all the wrong facts, finally gains confidence and speak up.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Mawar and Florence decide to start a business, selling clothes online. Florence becomes the model of all Mawar’s designs. This business becomes successful and popular in such a short and demands are overwhelming. It takes a toll on Mawar’s studies. Florence convinces her that she needs to focus on school. Mawar argues that she doesn’t need to study because her business is doing so well. Florence quits the business. Mawar can’t do the business alone and has a hard time designing because Florence is her muse and it’s more fun with Florence. They decide to close the business and focus on school.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: PE class. The PE teacher injures himself while warming up the class. Zack has to take over. The boys want to play football, and the girls want to play volleyball. Zack tries to get them to do other activities such as high jump, 100-meter dash, etc. Danial challenges Zack on a high jump, shot put, and 100-meter dash. If Danial wins 2 out of 3, they get to play football next week. Zack agrees to do the challenge. Danial wins the high jump. Zack wins the shot-put challenge. Lastly, the 100-meter dash. Zack wins by a close distance. But he promises the students that they get to play football and volleyball anyway because as long as they exercise, it’s okay. But the girls play football, and the boys have to play volleyball.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Drama class. Cikgu Lakshmi teaches the students acting and the art of theatre. They put on a very bad show. The acting’s horrendous, the pronunciation of words is wrong, and they lack confidence. But Cikgu Lakshmi is patient. James Blond, who checks out the class out of curiousity, watches their show and stands in for one of the students, just to test out his acting skills. He puts on a show and overacts in his scenes, way too dramatic, a stark contrast of the students. His performance is distracting. Cikgu Lakshmi decides to make it a student-only affair. James Blond is disappointed because he can’t express himself onstage anymore. One day, when school ends, he goes up on the empty stage and begins monologuing without realizing that Cikgu Lakshmi is watching him.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students pull a prank on Wan Yunus, the gullible new student from Kelantan. They tell him that his crush, Florence, likes him but she is too shy to tell him. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. They teach him all the basics like ordering food at a mamak restaurant, the salutations such as "macha", "brader" (not ‘brother’), "boss", etc. Wan Yunus teaches him how to flirt in Kelantanese dialect. In the end, he uses his knowledge to impress Cikgu Joji and takes her out on a date.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up

They lie to him about what Florence likes and gets him to dress silly, do silly things, and say silly things to her. He ends up embarrassing himself. The pranksters call it quits and apologize to them when they realize they’ve taken it too far. Wan Yunus forgives them. In the end, Florence tells him that she thinks Wan Yunus is cool and they can be friends. It makes Wan Yunus happy.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: James Blond decides to learn more about the locals. The students are happy to help. They teach him all the basics like ordering food at a mamak restaurant, the salutations such as "macha", "brader" (not ‘brother’), "boss", etc. Wan Yunus teaches him how to flirt in Kelantanese dialect. In the end, he uses his knowledge to impress Cikgu Joji and takes her out on a date.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Malaysia Day. Class decoration competition lead by Gowri. They excel in the competition, winning first place. However, before they can receive the grand prize the judge, principal Puan Aida, asks them what exactly is Malaysia Day. None of the students can answer (even James Blond). The whole class is punished. Cikgu Joji educates them on Malaysia Day while all of them stand on their chairs.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Sports Day. Zack, being the representative teacher for Rumah Sultan, trains the students for the main and most popular event which is the tug-of-war. He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Vitagen holds an audition session at SMK Ayer Dalam. Fiona is excited because she is very interested in Vitagen drink. Encik Yusof also wants to grab the golden opportunity to appear on the TV screen.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Sports Day. Zack, being the representative teacher for Rumah Sultan, trains the students for the main and most popular event which is the tug-of-war. He takes it way too seriously and his training is gruelling. On Sports Day, the team coached by James Blond (Rumah Lannister) wins and Zack’s team defeated. Zack demands a match between the coaches and challenges James Blond for a one-on-one tug-of-war. Puan Aida stops the match and makes the two teachers realize of how foolish and childish their rivalry is. Sports Day is about the students and for the students. They apologize to each other. But when Puan Aida goes away, the students ask them to continue the match as they cheer on.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Ronaldo has the flu but still attends school. He tries his best to hide it but James Blond finds out and tells him that he needs to go to the doctor and rest at home. But Ronaldo insists that he’s okay and the lessons should go on. But he keeps interfering the lesson by sneezing, coughing, and making everyone uncomfortable. In the end, James Blond takes Ronaldo to the teachers’ office and asks Encik Yusof to take care of the class. Ronaldo finally admits he’s sick and takes advantage of James Blond’s hospitality by being a demanding patient. A few days later, the whole class is down with flu. Ronaldo is the only one who’s well.

programme.title: Introducing Vijaya
programme.desc: Cheerful host Vijaya Selvaraju shows us just how easy Indian dishes can be incorporated into everyday meals.

programme.title: Popular
programme.desc: Chef Dev shares straightforward recipes for street foods that have gained popularity around the world. including Dan Dan Noodles from China. Doner Kebab from Turkey. and Samosas from India.

programme.title: USA + India
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: India, Belgium, Italy, China
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by India - Bhindi Masala-Style Nopales, Belgium - Belgian Plantain Waffles, Italy - Almond Crusted Portobellos, and China - Sichuan Artichoke Stir Fry!

programme.title: Curry in a Hurry Night
programme.desc: Indian meals are the epitome of a full family dinner. Host Spencer Watts uses bold flavours to make classic Butter Chicken and refreshing Mango Lassi.

programme.title: Okra and Oats
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Indian Classics
programme.desc: Ever crave a delicious Indian feast? Host Vijaya Selvaraju cooks up Indian classics for a delightful family meal.

programme.title: Craving Vegan

programme.title: USA + India
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: India, Belgium, Italy, China
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by India - Bhindi Masala-Style Nopales, Belgium - Belgian Plantain Waffles, Italy - Almond Crusted Portobellos, and China - Sichuan Artichoke Stir Fry!

programme.title: Curry in a Hurry Night
programme.desc: Indian meals are the epitome of a full family dinner. Host Spencer Watts uses bold flavours to make classic Butter Chicken and refreshing Mango Lassi.

programme.title: Okra and Oats
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: OPA!
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: Lettuce Eat Lasagna
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: Cheese with Every Meal!
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: Classic Greek Recipes
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: Soup and Sandwich
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the most tantalizing soup and sandwich! Josh makes a chicken satay sandwich and coconut tamarind soup while Erica prepares lamb kofta and carrot ginger soup!

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: Spring Inspiration
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Dangerous Contact
programme.desc: Nine hundred children are sent home from school and thousands inoculated during an outbreak in Massachusetts that depletes local supplies of antibiotics and lands four middle school students in the hospital. Ten-year-old Kayla St. Pierre spends ten days in critical care and loses all of her fingers and both legs to the disease. Scientists trace the disease to members of the Girls Club sharing lip gloss on a bus ride to see Disney on Ice, an excursion that exposes thousands of students from 19 schools to an aggressive strain of meningococcal meningitis

programme.title: Happily Never After: Final Status Update
programme.desc: Cassie and Brett are a match made in social media heaven, but when Cassie disappears, the police suspect that an online feud has entered the real world.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting- The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals. Fingerprints, along with palmprints and footprints are an indisputable, time-tested method to establish someone’s ID beyond a shadow of a doubt. Computerization has all but eliminated the old inkpad, and print identification that used to take months now takes minutes.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Vanishing Bride
programme.desc: Lisa and Lawrence have big plans for their future, but everything is ruined when Lisa vanishes. An investigation reveals a jealous ex, a threatening soldier, and a betrayal.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We’ve all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i’s and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Death Shift
programme.desc: An unassuming male nurse from Kentucky comes under scrutiny when hospital officials notice that death is unusually prominent during his work shifts. In fact, death seemed to follow Donald Harvey from job to job, beginning in 1970 and ending with his arrest in 1987. Harvey – probably the most prolific serial murderer in the nation’s history – claimed to have murdered his ailing charges out of compassion, but his meticulous diary, 30 pounds of cyanide, and a witch’s brew of dangerous drugs discovered in his home pointed to darker motives. And his quiet rampage would have likely continued, if not for the vigilant coroner who decided to investigate further the odd smell of almonds coming from his fresh corpse.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Shattered Sisterhood
programme.desc: Sandy is shot two days before her wedding to Dave. The consequent investigation reveals an ex, and a mystery woman were involved, and not a botched robbery as first suspected.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker – the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else. Detectives show us what forensic techniques, the VICAP system and clever investigating have done to bring these killers to justice.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history’s most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. Shipman’s patients seem to be dying at an unusually high rate, and their dead bodies had a similarity when he called to collect them – almost all were elderly women who lived alone and they died sitting in chairs while fully clothed. "There was never anything in the house that I saw that indicated the person had been ill," the undertaker remembers. "It just seems the person, where they were, had died. There was something that didn’t quite fit." Shipman is found guilty and given fifteen life sentences. A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

A clinical audit commissioned by the Department of Health estimates Shipman is responsibility for the deaths of at least 236 patients over a 24-year period, although unofficial estimates put the number between 400 and 1,000.

programme.title: Happily Never After: Shattered Sisterhood

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker – the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else. programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Deadly Medicine
programme.desc: Dr. Harold 'Fred' Shipman was known as a dedicated, hardworking and community-minded doctor who spent his life gaining the trust of his patients and the respect of his colleagues. And for 25 years, nobody suspected that the town doctor was amassing a death toll that would make him one of history’s most prolific serial killers. The local undertaker is among the first to notice a strange pattern. programme.title: Happily Never After: Hunted By Love
programme.desc: Cupid's arrow hits the mark with Bruce and his gal Janice. But during a three-month anniversary hunting trip, a bullet shatters their union. But who fired it?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can’t be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim’s remains, but they are often no matches for creative and devoted investigators. A speck of blood, a piece of a fingernail or a strand of hair may now be enough evidence to prove a murder and capture a killer.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death’s door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore’s symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore’s vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore’s two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E032
programme.desc: Aunque Victoria quiere que Hilario se olvide de Nicolás de una vez; el señor Guanipa está seguro de que llegará el día en que ella misma le pedirá que le cobre a Del Casal lo que le hizo, pues no va a poder vivir con tanta rabia. Fernanda se molesta al saber que Nicolás estuvo en Cantarrana. Nicolás comenta con Florencia que está seguro de que Fernanda se las ingenió para mandar desde su computadora un montón de cartas que le hicieron creer a Victoria que él la ha estado engañando; el joven está convencido de que la joven Zapata no es quien está ayudando a su tía y duda que haya sido Hilario quien contratara a alguien que lo hiciera como ella sugiere. Nicolás le cuenta a Fernanda de los papeles que encontró en Los Samanes; el joven asevera que, aunque Victoria los destruyó, él recuerda varios nombres y piensa que con eso, y lo que Rosendo le contara a Florencia, pueden empezar a buscar pruebas en contra de Guanipa.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E033
programme.desc: Nicolás afirma que desea vengarse de Hilario lo antes posible, pues ahora también tiene que cobrarle que lo apartara de la mujer que ama. Hilario quiere desaparecer a Nicolás, pero Victoria no quiere tragedias, sino arruinar al joven Del Casal y toda su familia. Adelaida relee las supuestas cartas de Hilario, pero las esconde cuando el hombre llega a su lado; la señora acepta las caricias de su esposo aunque se siente muy confundida por lo que acaba de descubrir. A Felipe le extraña cuando Hansen le ordena que prepare una carpeta con todos los negocios que tienen en Cantarrana, pues debe viajar de inmediato para la hacienda. La sorpresa se apodera de Clementina cuando Antonieta la busca para decirle que no se pude casar con Felipe.

programme.desc: Conscientes de que Ignacio podría emprender una demanda legal contra ellos, Carlos Raúl señala a su hermano, con velada intención, que deben permanecer unidos.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E038
programme.desc: Nicolás quiere que Sigfrido lo ayude a ponerle una flor en la habitación todos los días a Victoria; el joven Del Casal acusa sorpresa cuando el niño le comenta que acaba de ver a Jack dándole un beso a Victoria. Victoria le comenta a Hilario sobre los papeles y las fotos que Nicolás encontró en Los Samanes y que ella destruyó al quemar la casa; la muchacha asegura a su padre ya se convenció de que nunca más puede creer en Nicolás. Hansen indaga con Felipe quién es Jack Builder, pues le llama la atención que el hombre estuvo haciéndole varias preguntas sobre Hilario a alguien con quien Guanipa está por cerrar un negocio. Adelaida se llena de indignación cuando Genara le cuenta que Hilario se fue en la avioneta y no está en la hacienda como le aseguró. programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E89
programme.desc: Pese a la furia que despierta en su madre, Raúl certifica a Pastora que sigue enamorado de Clara Inés.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E05 - Neighbours, Old and New
programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E06 - No Place Like Home
programme.desc: As the end of their expedition draws near, salmon and bear activity begins to decline, but that doesn’t mean that there aren’t some bears still lingering around the area. Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E01 - Lay Of The Land
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary. A seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around the Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E02 - On The Tiger Trail
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find their first tiger. While the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E03 - Into The Tiger's Bedroom
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps.Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle? After walking a riverbed, the team gets an intimate look at these rare cats.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E02 - Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E03 - Tiger Shark
programme.desc: Ever wondered how a tiger shark hunts and feeds on its prey? Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E51 - Return of the Wolves
programme.desc: Capture teams from the U.S. National Park Service track down and relocate wolves to Isle Royale National Park in Lake Superior under an ambitious initiative to restore balance to a wilderness ecosystem.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E59 - Saving the Right Whale
programme.desc: The North Atlantic Right Whale is on the verge of extinction. The leading cause of death and injury to the whales is from ship strikes or entanglement in fishing lines. In this Breakthrough episode, we will hear from the leading experts and biologists who are racing to save this species.

programme.desc: Casey and the crew go out in search of the family of the lost cub from the previous night. They hope that if they find them, the cub will have found them as well.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E06 - No Place Like Home
programme.desc: As the end of their expedition draws near, salmon and bear activity begins to decline, but that doesn’t mean that there aren’t some bears still lingering around the area. Casey and his crew wander the tidal flats and interior of Katmai and find the bones of a humpback whale that washed ashore.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E01 - Lay Of The Land
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. Casey and his camera crew arrive in Nepal and meet up with local tiger guide, Rajan Chadhary. A seasoned tracker, Rajan guides the team around the Bardiya National Park's tiger habitat and establishes a lay of the land.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E02 - On The Tiger Trail
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps. While walking in the jungle, Casey and the team find their first tiger. While the tracks lead to a lot of dead ends, they discover a plethora of other wildlife along the way.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers Of Nepal - S01:E03 - Into The Tiger's Bedroom
programme.desc: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers, but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps.Casey and Rajan discuss different tactics for finding tigers: sit and wait for them to come to the water, or track them on foot through the jungle? After walking a riverbed, the team gets an intimate look at these rare cats.

programme.desc: On this episode we take to the links and marvel at Seve Ballesteros, the man who made the Ryder Cup a contest, and Greg Norman, the Great White Shark who shook up the establishment.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E13 - Rooney, England, Charlton, Three Lions, Manchester United, Ballon d'Or
programme.desc: Bobby Charlton. One of England’s many heroes of 1966. A man who overcame so much to achieve great things. While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.
